sources.snippet: Abstract Self-supervised bioacoustic encoders have been used for species classification but so far have not addressed syllable-level structure in birdsong. We introduce SongMAE, a compact MAE-ViT (Masked Autoencoder Vision Transformer) that operates on mel spectrograms with 2 ms temporal resolution. SongMAE is pre-trained with masked spectrogram reconstruction on diverse bioacoustic recordings ...

sources.title: SongMAE: A bioacoustic encoder for birdsong - labs.sciety.org
sources.snippet: The architecture of existing self-supervised bioacoustic encoders has largely been inherited from human speech models; as a result, these encoders operate at temporal resolutions designed for human speech.
